description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a proven leader to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence. The role offers a highly competitive salary, reflecting the importance of this leadership position.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations while fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. This is an urgent opening for a dedicated professional ready to drive quality outcomes and operational efficiency.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing SNFs.
Demonstrated leadership, financial management, and operational skills.
Commitment to delivering high-quality patient care and resident satisfaction.
salaryOrBonusInfo: This role offers a highly competitive salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
